in_marathi.name: Ramavath
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramavath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ramavath is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rama', which means 'Joy'. In Hinduism, Rama is the seventh avatar of Lord Vishnu and the prince of Ayodhya. He is known for his unwavering devotion to his wife Sita and his commitment to dharma.
